name: Caterpillar D9 armoured bulldozer (IDF)
armament: FN MAG or Samson RCWS on some
protection: IAI armour kit with armoured cab, bulletproof windows and slat armour. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetration needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon, best against side, rear and engine deck. Game use: clears rubble, berms and IED-suspected routes; destroys map structures.
visual_notes: Huge front dozer blade and rear ripper tine
Tall armoured cab with small thick armoured windows and roof cage
Slat armour around engine and cab
Unmanned 'Panda' version has no crew but carries sensors and antennas
